---
title: "Photography"
editor: visual
listing:
  contents: photography
  type: grid
  image-height: "100%"
  grid-columns: 4
  page-size: 20
  grid-item-border: false
  fields: [image]
  sort-ui: [date,categories]
  categories: true
  sort:
    - "date desc"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <style>

      /* --- EVEN, UNIFORM THUMBNAILS FOR LISTING GRIDS --- */

      /* Container for the image */
      .quarto-grid .quarto-grid-item .thumbnail {
        aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;  /* change to 4 / 3 or 3 / 2 if preferred */
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: 6px;   /* optional: rounded corners */
      }

      /* The image inside the container */
      .quarto-grid .quarto-grid-item .thumbnail img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;    /* crops to fill the shape evenly */
      }

      </style>
---
